dsl-page: page is the root widget of every ui/app.json. Required fields: type:'page', content:<Widget>. Optional: title:string (used by host chrome for tab labels), state.initial:object (initial state map for {{...}} bindings), lifecycle.onInit:Action (runs once after the runtime mounts), lifecycle.onDestroy:Action. Example: {"type":"page","title":"Counter","state":{"initial":{"count":0}},"content":{"type":"text","text":"{{count}}"}}. The page widget has no visual chrome of its own — it just hosts the content tree.
dsl-box: box is the basic single-child container. Replaces Flutter's Container. Properties: child:<Widget>, padding:number|EdgeInsets, margin:number, width:number, height:number, color:string (hex like #RRGGBB), decoration:object, alignment:'topLeft'|'center'|'bottomRight'|etc. Use box for padding, background colour, fixed dimensions. Do NOT use 'container' — the canonical lowercase name is 'box'. Example: {"type":"box","padding":16,"color":"#1F2A3A","child":{"type":"text","text":"hello"}}.
dsl-linear: linear is the row/column layout widget. Replaces Flutter's Row/Column. Required: type:'linear', children:[<Widget>...]. Properties: direction:'horizontal'|'vertical' (default horizontal), gap:number (spacing between children), mainAxisAlignment:'start'|'center'|'end'|'spaceBetween'|'spaceAround'|'spaceEvenly', crossAxisAlignment:'start'|'center'|'end'|'stretch', mainAxisSize:'min'|'max'. Example vertical: {"type":"linear","direction":"vertical","gap":8,"children":[{"type":"text","text":"a"},{"type":"text","text":"b"}]}.
dsl-text: text renders a string. Required: type:'text', text:string (alias `content`). The runtime also accepts `value` as a third fallback, but 1.4 does not declare it — author `text`, or the conformance check rejects a document that renders. Properties: style:object (fontSize:number, fontWeight:'bold'|'normal'|'w100'..'w900', color:string, fontFamily:string), variant:string (Material 3 typography role — camelCase: displayLarge, displayMedium, displaySmall, headlineLarge..Small, titleLarge..Small, bodyLarge..Small, labelLarge..Small — 15 roles total), maxLines:number, overflow:'ellipsis'|'fade'|'clip'. variant is layered with style. Example: {"type":"text","text":"Hello {{name}}","variant":"titleMedium","style":{"color":"#7DD3FC"}}.
dsl-button: button is a clickable action surface. Required: type:'button', label:string, onTap:Action. The tap handler property is named `onTap`; `click` and `onPressed` are accepted aliases (§17.3.2). Do NOT use a property named `action` — the runtime ignores it. Properties: variant:'elevated'|'filled'|'outlined'|'text'|'icon' (default 'elevated'; those five are the whole set — 'tonal' is not one of them and is rejected), icon:IconRef, enabled:bool. onTap is canonical {type:'tool', tool:'<name>', params:{...}} (see actions doc). Example: {"type":"button","label":"Submit","variant":"filled","onTap":{"type":"tool","tool":"shout","params":{"text":"{{input}}"}}}.
dsl-list: list renders a collection. Required: type:'list', either children:[<Widget>...] OR items:array + itemTemplate:<Widget>. With itemTemplate, each row is rendered from the template with {{item}} and {{index}} bound to the current entry. Properties: orientation:'vertical'|'horizontal' (default vertical), spacing:number, emptyMessage:string, itemExtent:number, shrinkWrap:bool and padding:number|EdgeInsets are read by the runtime but not declared in 1.4 — they work at run time and the conformance check rejects them, so prefer a surrounding box for padding. Use itemTemplate over children for bound dynamic lists. Example: {"type":"list","items":"{{todos}}","shrinkWrap":true,"itemTemplate":{"type":"linear","children":[{"type":"text","text":"{{item.title}}"}]}}.
dsl-sizedBox: sizedBox is a fixed-size empty box. Common as a spacer in linear children. Properties: width:number, height:number, child:<Widget> (optional). Example spacer: {"type":"sizedBox","height":12}. Use linear.gap instead of sizedBox spacers when possible.
dsl-card: card is an elevated container with rounded corners + shadow. Material 3 surface. Required: type:'card', child:<Widget>. Properties: elevation:number, margin:number, color:string. card declares no padding and the runtime does not read one — wrap the child in a box for inner spacing. {"type":"card","child":{"type":"text","text":"card body"}}.
dsl-conditional: conditional renders one of two branches based on a boolean binding. Required: type:'conditional', condition:bool|string, then:<Widget>. Optional: else:<Widget>. condition evaluates via _isTruthy: null/false/0/empty-string/empty-list/empty-map are falsy. Note: equality expressions like {{a == b}} are NOT supported — use plain bindings to a precomputed boolean OR rely on truthy/falsy of values. Example: {"type":"conditional","condition":"{{loaded}}","then":{"type":"text","text":"ready"},"else":{"type":"text","text":"loading…"}}.
dsl-expanded: expanded is a flexible-fill child inside a linear. Replaces Flutter's Expanded. Required: type:'expanded', child:<Widget>. Properties: flex:number (default 1). Use inside linear when one child should absorb remaining space. Example: {"type":"linear","children":[{"type":"text","text":"left"},{"type":"expanded","child":{"type":"text","text":"fills"}}]}.
dsl-icon: icon renders a Material icon. The property is `icon`, not `name` — the factory reads only `properties['icon']`, so `name` renders nothing. Required: type:'icon', icon:string (Material icon name like 'home', 'add', 'folder_open', 'settings'). Properties: size:number, color:string. Example: {"type":"icon","icon":"home","size":20,"color":"#7DD3FC"}. Common names: home, add, close, edit, delete, folder, folder_open, settings, info, warning, error, search, refresh, play_arrow, stop, chevron_left, chevron_right, expand_more, expand_less, more_vert, extension, star, push_pin, history.
custom-ToolForm: ToolForm auto-generates a form from a tool's inputSchema (JSON Schema). Required: type:'ToolForm', tool:'<name>', inputSchema:object. Optional: submitLabel:string (default 'Submit'), bindResult:string (state key to merge result into; default = auto-merge top-level), loadingBinding:string (bool flag flipped during submission). Field type mapping: string→TextField; number/integer→numeric TextField; boolean→Switch; string+enum→Dropdown. Example: {"type":"ToolForm","tool":"shout","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"}}}}.
custom-ToolResult: ToolResult renders the last tool result with type-aware fields based on outputSchema. Required: type:'ToolResult', resultBinding:string (state key holding the result), outputSchema:object. Properties: emptyMessage:string. Pairs with ToolForm or any tool action — auto-merge populates the state key, ToolResult re-renders. Example: {"type":"ToolResult","resultBinding":"shouted","outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"shouted":{"type":"string"}}}}.
custom-ToolPicker: ToolPicker renders a dropdown of available tools and dispatches the selected one on change. Required: type:'ToolPicker', tools:array of tool names. Properties: label:string, value:string (currently selected — usually bound to state). Use when the UI lets the user pick which tool to run before forming inputs.
custom-VbuTitleBar: VbuTitleBar is the studio's chrome-style strip for the top of a bundle's page — full-width, 28px tall (VbuTokens.titlebarHeight, matches the studio's own titlebar), `surface` background, `borderDefault` 1px bottom border, mono 12pt w600 title. Tool aesthetic — thin and quiet. When a page needs a header bar, this atom usually fits and keeps the bundle's tone consistent with the studio chrome around it. Required: type:'VbuTitleBar', title:string. Properties: subtitle:string (small secondary line shown inline with a · separator, mono 11pt), leading:<Widget> (small leading icon, optional), trailing:[<Widget>...] (small icon buttons / VbuPills, optional — 14-16px icons match the tool tone), height:number (default 28), background:string (hex; defaults to surface token). Pairs naturally with `linear(direction:'vertical', crossAxisAlignment:'stretch')` at page root + `expanded` body below. Example minimal: {"type":"VbuTitleBar","title":"My App"}. Example with subtitle + trailing: {"type":"VbuTitleBar","title":"Counter","subtitle":"count {{count}}","trailing":[{"type":"icon","icon":"settings","size":14}]}. When the user asks for something taller / larger-font (44px+, 16pt+ titles, prominent shadow), that's typically a mobile-AppBar request — suggest the lighter atom first and confirm; the studio is a desktop tool, so a mobile-style header usually reads as out-of-place inside it.
custom-VbuPaneHeader: VbuPaneHeader is the studio's panel-title bar — small uppercase label + optional trailing actions + optional clear button. Required: type:'VbuPaneHeader', label:string. Properties: actions:[<Widget>...] (trailing icons/buttons), onClear:Action (renders an X icon, fires this action), clearTooltip:string, height:number (default 36). Example: {"type":"VbuPaneHeader","label":"RECENT","actions":[]}. Distinct from VbuTitleBar: VbuPaneHeader = uppercase SECTION label inside a panel; VbuTitleBar = window-chrome strip across the top of the whole page.
custom-VbuPill: VbuPill is a small rounded chip — badge or tag. Required: type:'VbuPill', label:string. Properties: leading:<Widget> (icon before label), onTap:Action, background:string (hex color), foreground:string (hex color). Default: studio's subtle pill colour. Example: {"type":"VbuPill","label":"draft","background":"#22C55E","foreground":"#0B1220"}.
custom-VbuLabelledField: VbuLabelledField is a label-prefixed text input — studio form convention. Required: type:'VbuLabelledField', label:string, hint:string. Properties: value:string (initial value binding), obscure:bool (password-style), trailing:<Widget>, labelWidth:number (default 92), onChanged:Action (fires with each keystroke; the new text is in {{$event}}). Example: {"type":"VbuLabelledField","label":"Name","hint":"my-project","value":"{{name}}","onChanged":{"type":"tool","tool":"setName","params":{"name":"{{$event}}"}}}.
custom-VbuLabelledToggle: VbuLabelledToggle is a label-prefixed switch. Required: type:'VbuLabelledToggle', label:string, value:bool, onChanged:Action. Properties: hint:string. onChanged receives the new bool in {{$event}}. Example: {"type":"VbuLabelledToggle","label":"Enable","value":"{{enabled}}","hint":"toggle the feature","onChanged":{"type":"tool","tool":"setEnabled","params":{"v":"{{$event}}"}}}.
custom-VbuLabelledMenu: VbuLabelledMenu is a label-prefixed dropdown. Required: type:'VbuLabelledMenu', label:string, value:any, options:[any...], onChanged:Action. Properties: labels:map{value→displayLabel}, labelWidth:number (default 92). Picked value lands in {{$event}}. Example: {"type":"VbuLabelledMenu","label":"Mode","value":"{{mode}}","options":["dev","prod"],"labels":{"dev":"Development","prod":"Production"},"onChanged":{"type":"tool","tool":"setMode","params":{"m":"{{$event}}"}}}.
custom-VbuSystemNote: VbuSystemNote is a callout / banner for informational or error messages. Required: type:'VbuSystemNote', text:string. Properties: error:bool (red-styled when true), onDelete:Action (renders dismiss X). Default is the studio's subtle note tone. Example info: {"type":"VbuSystemNote","text":"Saved — 3 changes"}. Example error: {"type":"VbuSystemNote","text":"Permission denied","error":true}.
custom-VbuBusyIndicator: VbuBusyIndicator is a small rotating-dots spinner with optional label. Properties: label:string (default 'thinking…'), dotColor:string, cycleMs:number (default 1200 ms). Use to indicate background work. Example: {"type":"VbuBusyIndicator","label":"loading…"}.
custom-VbuFormSection: VbuFormSection wraps a labelled group of form fields with consistent spacing. Required: type:'VbuFormSection', label:string, children:[<Widget>...]. Properties: rowGap:number (default 8). Use as the outer container for related VbuLabelledField/VbuLabelledToggle/VbuLabelledMenu rows. Example: {"type":"VbuFormSection","label":"AUTH","children":[{"type":"VbuLabelledField","label":"Email","hint":"you@example.com","value":"{{email}}"}]}.
custom-VbuStatusbar: VbuStatusbar is a thin bottom strip with left and right slot lists — common chrome footer pattern. Required: type:'VbuStatusbar'. Properties: left:[<Widget>...], right:[<Widget>...], height:number (default 22), gap:number (default 16). Use inside the page body for a custom status line; the host chrome already has its own statusbar so don't duplicate.
